label: Diagram 14
caption: Diagram 14 Sizes of openings and recesses
description: The drawing is titled "Diagram 14 Sizes of openings and recesses", with the text "See para 2C29" at the top left. It contains two line drawings of a wall. The left wall, broken at both ends, shows two bottom openings dimensioned W1 and W2 and a dashed recess dimensioned W3; vertical dashed lines mark the "Centre line of buttressing wall, pier or chimney" at each end, and a dimension line between them reads "L = length of wall". Spans along the base are labelled P1, P2, P3 and P4. The right wall, broken at one end, shows one opening W4 and span P5; its top edge is the "Outer face of return wall", a right‑hand height is marked "H should not be greater than 2.1 m", and the base is captioned "corner of two external walls". Below, a "Notes" panel headed "Requirements (refer to Table 8 for values of Factor X)" lists eight numbered items giving requirements (inequalities) for W1 to W4, L and P1 to P5, most in terms of a Factor X, item 8 stating X may be 6 where the declared compressive strength is not less than 7.3N/mm².
